results.note: The validator require_one_frozen_detection_declaration (ingest/registry.py:165) rejects an entry that declares neither frozen_after_observations nor expected_constant, and one that declares both. Line 192 tests the neither case and line 202 tests the both case. Line 387 checks every shipped entry.

The validator at ingest/registry.py:176-194 requires every TA-Lib entry to set exactly one of derives_from or frozen_propagation_unavailable. Line 215 tests the neither case and line 243 tests the both case.
IndicatorRegistry.validate_derived_roots (registry.py:232-244) rejects a derives_from that names an unknown key or the entry itself. The test asserts both error messages.
IndicatorDefinition declares frozen_after_observations, expected_constant, derives_from, frozen_propagation_unavailable and freshness_unmeasurable at lines 126-130.

registry.yaml is filled in with real values: thresholds, expected_constant on the funding rates, derives_from, the unavailability reason and the freshness_unmeasurable reasons. The tests at lines 387, 397, 409 and 423 load the shipped registry and assert on those values.
All BTC TA-Lib entries have derives_from set to the real registered btc_daily_close, and none of them sets frozen_propagation_unavailable.
ETH/SOL/BNB TA-Lib entries leave derives_from unset and carry the exact documented reason as frozen_propagation_unavailable. The fabricated eth/sol/bnb_daily_close rows are removed.

A direct check: this test compares the full key→definable_for mapping against the hard-coded 81-row baseline SHIPPED_REGISTRY_DEFINABLE_FOR at line 40, which excludes eth/sol/bnb_daily_close. Adding, removing or changing definable_for on any row now fails the test. Relative to the base commit the diff removes three rows, but those were the fabricated cells from the earlier failed attempts, and removing them restores the true board.
stablecoin_supply and sol_staking each carry a freshness_unmeasurable reason that names the fetch wall clock, and the test asserts on both.

assert_registry_coverage (ingest/registry.py:399-427) now enforces the frozen-detection declaration, the TA-Lib propagation declaration, and self or unknown derives_from. test_coverage.py lines 110, 124, 141 and 155 drive each failure through the coverage gate, and line 226 runs it over the real registry.
